rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital nomad and remote worker visa (decree of 29 February 2024)
rows.value: Highly qualified remote work (art. 27-quater D.Lgs. 286/1998); at least 6 months' experience; health insurance and housing; no work permit (nulla osta) for digital nomads
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).
rows.source_title: Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 79 del 4 aprile 2024: Ministero dell'Interno, decreto 29 febbraio 2024 (nomadi digitali e lavoratori da remoto), artt. 3-6

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital nomad visa: minimum income
rows.value: At least 3 times the income limit for exemption from healthcare co-payments, per year, from lawful sources
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital nomad residence permit: valid for at most (years), renewable yearly
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital nomad visa: where to apply
rows.value: Italian embassy or consulate for the visa; then the Questura within 8 working days of arrival for the permit. Digital nomads must register for an Italian VAT number (partita IVA); Italian social security applies unless a bilateral convention says otherwise
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).
rows.source_title: Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 79 del 4 aprile 2024: Ministero dell'Interno, decreto 29 febbraio 2024 (nomadi digitali e lavoratori da remoto), artt. 3-6

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Elective residence visa (DM 850/2011)
rows.value: For people who can support themselves without working in Italy: income of at least 3 times the Interior Ministry's Tabella A amount from pensions, annuities, property or businesses (not employment); applied for at the Italian embassy or consulate
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).
rows.source_title: Ministero degli Affari Esteri: Decreto interministeriale 11 maggio 2011, n. 850 (visa types), allegato A, point 13 (Visto per residenza elettiva)
